messages:
Carla M: Hey team — I'm going to need to swap out of tonight's primary. Got a family emergency. Can someone pick up primary from 23:00 UTC onward? I'm available until 22:30 UTC to do a clean handoff.

Ben K: @Carla M sorry to hear that — I can cover primary from 23:00–03:00 UTC but will need a quick runbook refresh before you leave.

Carla M: Thanks @Ben K — brief notes: the most likely alerts are propagation-latency and model-oom spikes. Incident runbook link here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall/inference-paging (pin this). Key commands: ```./scripts/shift-handoff.sh --export-context && tail -n 200 /var/log/inference/runtime.log``` and check the kv-cache hit rate metric in Grafana (dashboard id: infra-llm-ops).

incident-bot: [ALERT] 1916154321.1 - propagation-latency (p1) triggered on prod:region-eu. Pager duty: page_primary.

oncall-ops-bot: Attached runbook snippet: "If propagation-latency > 500ms for >3m: 1) check network egress to s3 for model weights; 2) check model shard health; 3) failover to fresher replica policy id: failover-policy-v3"

Priya S: @Ben K fyi I've been watching the failover flapping from last week (we saw 4x failovers in 2h). If you see a pattern, escalate to SRE and move traffic to dedicated-reserve pool per runbook.

Ben K: Copy. @Priya S can you stay as secondary for the first hour after the swap? If propagation-latency spikes I may need you to triage KV cache evictions.

Priya S: Yep I'll be online. Also, make sure you run `kubectl get pods -n inference -l shard=primary -o wide` if failover starts — look for CrashLoopBackOff or high restart counts.

Aisha R: Quick question — who owns customer comms if we start a P1? Last time product asked oncall to draft the notice. We should clarify handoff: primary oncall owns mitigation, secondary helps diagnostics, Pager duty owner triggers comms.

Carla M: Agree — convention: primary runs mitigation and initial post (short status), secondary supports diagnostics/metrics and draft. I'll DM product to let them know coverage swap.

Ben K: Starting the handoff checklist now: 1) replicated config: `cat /etc/redwood/inference-config.yaml | grep traffic`; 2) confirm token keys rotated last-week; 3) confirm autoscaler target is 6/12. If anything looks off call me on pager.

incident-bot: [NOTE] Related incidents in last 7d: 1916150100-propagation-latency (same region) — remediation: increased batch window and applied patch v0.12.4 to model-runtime.

Ben K: Noted. Also setting a quick alert mute for noisy non-critical logs for the next 30m while we do swap: `/alerts mute --pattern "client-timeout" --for 30m` (ops-only).

Priya S: I've updated the runbook checklist in the thread with a short snippet to avoid repeating steps: ```Mitigation quick run: 1) check network bandwidth; 2) tail runtime logs for OOM strings; 3) trigger replica failover if >2 nodes unhealthy; 4) notify product and infra channels.```

Carla M: Thanks all. @Ben K take primary at 23:00 UTC. I'm handing over context via DM and attaching the export from `shift-handoff.sh` to PagerDuty ticket. Leaving now — ping me if anything critical in the next 30m. :pray:

Ben K: Got it. I'll grab the primary handoff at 23:00 and will update this thread with a short status at 23:15 UTC.

Priya S: Secondary confirmed. Will watch failovers and ket metrics (kv_hit_rate, batch_latency) and triage.

Aisha R: Product informed via DM. If we need a customer-facing note I'll draft a brief: "We're investigating intermittent latency affecting inference responses in EU. We're mitigating and will share updates every 30 minutes."

Carla M: Appreciate it — feel better about leaving it in your hands. :heart:

Ben K: Locking in swap. If incident escalates I'll page oncall-sre and mark this channel. Otherwise, will post handback summary at end of shift.

oncall-ops-bot: Handoff recorded: primary: Ben K (23:00–03:00 UTC), secondary: Priya S, original primary: Carla M. Handoff id: hoff-1916154321.

Ben K: Handback summary (post-shift): 23:10 — short propagation-latency spike resolved after increasing batch window; 01:05 — observed a single replica restart, scaled out one replica, no customer impact; 02:55 — handed back to day team. Full notes pushed to ticket PD-4321.

Carla M: Thanks team, heading offline now.
